transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get this weekly sustainment review underway. We've got used oil drums, vehicle batteries, expired medical cold packs, and empty compressed-air cylinders in the holding area, all awaiting disposition. Before I sign off on the disposition plan, I need updates from each of you. Environmental, what's the status on the used oil drums and vehicle batteries? Maintenance, any changes on the batteries or cylinders? Medical logistics, where do we stand on those expired cold packs? And transportation, do we have scheduled pickups or transfers lined up for any of these categories?

transcript.text: Good morning, Major. On the used oil, I confirmed this morning that we have exactly 18 drums accepted by the contracted recycling service, with pickup available on 26 June. On the vehicle batteries, I don't have a confirmed disposition yet from my end.

transcript.text: Major, on the vehicle batteries — I counted exactly 24 cases in the holding area. I'll make sure that gets reconciled before pickup.
